briefing.headline: OpenAI and xAI escalate multi-agent arms race with new coordination breakthroughs

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate toward AGI with rapid model releases and infrastructure buildouts. Multi-agent coordination and safety concerns dominate discussions amid rising geopolitical stakes.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI debuts o4-preview with advanced reasoning. Anthropic's Claude 4 and xAI's Grok-3 push boundaries in agentic tasks while DeepSeek releases efficient open weights.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. Regulators push for mandatory red-teaming standards.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA ships next-gen Blackwell clusters as Microsoft expands Azure AI regions. TSMC ramps 2nm production dedicated to AI accelerators.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent AI systems achieve autonomous goal alignment before 2028?
